id: title:danielcarletti:add a gil free restore and a delta rs table check

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse recovery and metadata existence checks to the Rust core, exposing these capabilities to Python bindings. This could support warehouse recovery or metadata checks without loading full table state.
review.reason: Adds a lightweight existence check and a restore operation to the Rust core, exposing them to Python. This could support warehouse recovery or metadata checks without loading full table state.
review.uncertainty: The exact operational benefit depends on warehouse recovery and metadata checks, which are not demonstrated in the provided observations. The tier is assigned based on the implementation of warehouse recovery and metadata checks, not the actual benefit.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative group. No score assigned.
